scripts.--todo: remove '--types chai' it is used just because tsc cli does not allow specifying empty types array with console flags
scripts.upload: npm run compile && npm run webidl2 && node tools/publish.mjs --tag next
scripts.release: npm run compile && npm run compile --prefix ../core && npm run compile --prefix linter && node tools/release.mjs
scripts.compile: npm run compile -C ../interfaces && npm run compile -C ../libohos && npm run compile:self
scripts.sanity: npm run all:subset:ts && npm run all:sdk:ts && npm run all:subset:arkts
scripts.compile:arkts:libs: npm run build -C ../external/incremental/runtime && npm run build -C ../external/interop
scripts.clean: rimraf build dist lib generated native/build* native/lib* native/cross* native/NativeBridge* native/ace* out external-subset
scripts.build-native:sdk:arkts: cd ./native && meson setup -Dsource_set=ets-arkts-peers build-sdk-arkts && meson compile --verbose -C build-sdk-arkts && meson install -C build-sdk-arkts
scripts.exec:sdk:arkts: ACE_LIBRARY_PATH=./native/build-sdk-arkts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./native bash ../external/incremental/tools/panda/arkts/ark --ark-entry-point arkui.framework.main.ETSGLOBAL::main --ark-boot-files ../external/interop/build/interop.abc:../external/incremental/runtime/build/incremental.abc:./out/ets-arkts-peers/abc out/ets-arkts-peers/abc/all.abc --driver-log info
scripts.all:sdk:arkts: npm run compile && npm run compile -C ../etsgen && npm run etsgen:sdk && npm run gen:sdk:arkts && npm run gen-modules:sdk:arkts && npm run build:sdk:arkts && npm run build-native:sdk:arkts && npm run compile:arkts:libs && npm run exec:sdk:arkts
scripts.build-native:subset:arkts: cd ./native && meson setup -Dsource_set=arkts-subset build-subset-arkts && meson compile --verbose -C build-subset-arkts && meson install -C build-subset-arkts
scripts.all:subset:arkts: npm run compile && npm run gen:subset:arkts && npm run build:subset:arkts && npm run build-native:subset:arkts && npm run compile:arkts:libs && npm run exec:subset:arkts
scripts.build-native:sdk:ts: cd ./native && meson setup -Dsource_set=ets-ts-peers build-sdk-ts && meson compile --verbose -C build-sdk-ts && meson install -C build-sdk-ts
scripts.all:sdk:ts: npm run compile && npm run compile -C ../dtsgen && npm run compile -C ../ohosgen && npm run setup:sdk:ts && npm run gen-idl:sdk:ts && npm run gen:sdk:ts && npm run gen-modules:sdk:ts && npm run build:sdk:ts && npm run build-native:sdk:ts && npm run exec:sdk:ts
scripts.build-native:subset:ts: cd ./native && meson setup -Dsource_set=ts-subset build-subset-ts && meson compile --verbose -C build-subset-ts && meson install -C build-subset-ts
scripts.all:subset:ts: npm run compile && npm run compile -C ../dtsgen && npm run setup:subset:ts && npm run gen-idl:subset:ts && npm run gen:subset:ts && npm run build:subset:ts && npm run build-native:subset:ts && npm run exec:subset:ts
scripts.test:subset-api: npm run gen:subset:arkts && mkdir -p out/test-subset-api && cp -r out/arkts-subset/generated/libace/generated/interface/arkoala_api_generated.h ./out/test-subset-api/arkoala_api_generated.h && node ../tools/golden.mjs --input-dir ./out/test-subset-api --golden-dir ./tests/golden/subset-api
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:root && npm run test:subset-api
scripts.tracker:ets: npm run compile && node . --idl2peer --reference-names generation-config/references/ets-sdk.refs.json --no-type-checker --input-files $(find ../etsgen/out/idl -type f | tr '\n' ' ') --output-dir ../doc --generator-target tracker --tracker-status ../doc/COMPONENTS_STATUS.md
scripts.tracker:ver: sed "1iSDK version:    `git -C ../interface_sdk-js rev-parse HEAD` `git -C ../interface_sdk-js name-rev --name-only HEAD`" -i ../doc/COMPONENTS.md && sed "1iIDLize Version: `git rev-parse HEAD` `git name-rev --name-only HEAD`" -i ../doc/COMPONENTS.md
scripts.tracker:ets:all: npm run tracker:ets && npm run tracker:ver
scripts.compile:cj:native:subset: npm run configure:cj:native:subset && cd native && meson compile --verbose -C build-cangjie-native-dummy
scripts.compile:cj:native: npm run configure:cj:native && cd native && meson compile --verbose -C build-cangjie-native-dummy
scripts.run:cj: npm run build:cj:callsitekey && npm run compile && node . --api-version 99 --dts2peer --base-dir ./,./tests/ --input-dir ./tests/cangjie-subset/ --output-dir ./out/cangjie/generated --language cangjie && npm run compile:cj:native && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./native/build-cangjie-native-dummy:./../external/incremental-cj/runtime/callsitekey:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH ACE_LIBRARY_PATH=./native/build-cangjie-native-dummy cjpm run
scripts.run:cj:full: npm run compile && node . --api-version 99 --dts2peer --base-dir ./,../sdk-patched/api,../sdk-patched/kits,../sdk-patched/arkts --input-dir ../sdk-patched/api/@internal/component/ets/,../sdk-patched/api/global --output-dir ./out/cangjie/generated --language cangjie && npm run compile:cj:native && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./native/build-cangjie-native-dummy:./../external/incremental-cj/runtime/callsitekey:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH ACE_LIBRARY_PATH=./native/build-cangjie-native-dummy cjpm run
scripts.generate:cj:idl: npm run compile && npm -C ../dtsgen run compile && node ../dtsgen --dts2idl --base-dir ./tests/cangjie-subset-idl/api --input-dir ./tests/cangjie-subset-idl/api/@internal/component/ets,./tests/cangjie-subset-idl/api,./tests/cangjie-subset-idl/api/arkui,./tests/cangjie-subset-idl/api/global --output-dir ./out/cangjie/generated/idl --options-file ./generation-config/config.json
scripts.check:subset:cj: npm run generate:cj:subset && npm run cj
scripts.make:kt: node . --api-version 99 --dts2peer --base-dir ./,./tests/kotlin-subset --input-dir ./tests/kotlin-subset/, --output-dir ./out/kotlin-subset/generated --language kotlin && npm run compile:kt:interop && mkdir -p ./out/kotlin-subset/bin && kotlinc ./out/kotlin-subset/generated/sig/arkoala-kotlin/framework/kotlin/src/*.kt -cp ../external/interop/build/kotlin-interop/bin/interop.jar -d ./out/kotlin-subset/bin/output.jar
scripts.compile:kt: npm run compile && npm run make:kt
